model.synthesis_status: Product code still sends model sarvam-m. Sarvam documents this model as deprecated and no longer available on Chat Completions.

dataset.label: GS-T7 fixture corpus. These texts are labeled fixtures, not live Firecrawl scrapes.

absent_claims.claim_units: Sentences from summary and tldr, plus bestFor, plus each pro, plus each con. Verdict is excluded because it is a classification, not a source fact.
absent_claims.tokenizer: Unicode letters and numbers, lowercase, tokens shorter than 3 dropped, stopwords dropped.
absent_claims.grounded_rule: A claim is grounded if at least 0.5 of its content tokens appear in the concatenated fixture sources for that product. Otherwise it is absent.
absent_claims.sources: Fixture review texts in dataset.json. Not live scrapes.
absent_claims.live_synthesis: Uses src/lib/pipeline/synthesize.ts when SARVAM_API_KEY is set. No mock summaries are scored.

live_redis.reason: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL or UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN is not set

cache.simulation: In-memory Map using the production review-cache key review:${slug} from src/lib/cache/reviews.ts and toSlug from src/lib/utils/slug.ts. Matches the query route skip of scrape plus synthesize on getCachedReview hit. Localized cache is not filled because localize is not run. Workload is the listed query sequence: 8 first-time products then 4 repeats. Cold start. Not padded to the spec 60% week-1 target.

cost.observed_usd: Not measured. This environment issued no billed Firecrawl or Sarvam calls.

assumptions: Matches src/lib/firecrawl/scraper.ts primary path: 3 searches (blog limit 5, ecommerce 4, youtube 3).
Each search limit is at most 10 results, so each search is 2 credits (Firecrawl: 2 credits per 10 results).
Assumes primary searches return enough trusted hits. Fallback searches in scraper.ts are not counted.
Assumes every selected URL scrapes successfully. Firecrawl states failed requests are not charged.
Ecommerce scrapes use JSON format (+4 credits per page) and do not fall back to a second markdown scrape.
USD uses published plan allotments from firecrawl.dev/pricing, not a live invoice.

firecrawl_usd_sources.headline_plan: standard_annual because Firecrawl labels Standard as recommended

sarvam_m.reason: sarvam-m is not listed on https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/getting-started/pricing. Deprecation: https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/getting-started/models/sarvam-m. No billed token counts were observed.

failures: live_redis: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL or UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN is not set
absent_claim_rate: no synthesized reviews. Product synthesizeReview was not run successfully. This checkout has no SARVAM_API_KEY, and sarvam-m is documented as deprecated.
